# AutoApply CV

> AutoApply CV is an AI job search platform for software engineers and tech professionals. Its Chrome extension auto-applies to LinkedIn Easy Apply jobs using saved, truthful screening answers, skips jobs already applied to, and pauses when a question needs a human answer. The dashboard tailors resumes for applicant tracking systems (ATS) and tracks every application. The Free plan includes 3 auto-apply actions per day; Pro costs ₹49 per month for unlimited auto-apply.

- [How it works](https://www.autoapplycv.in/how-it-works): Setup steps, page-ready submission checks, answer sync and pipeline tracking.
- [Pricing](https://www.autoapplycv.in/pricing): Free, Pro (₹49/month) and pay-as-you-go Hires credits, and what is and is not charged.
